newsitem.title: UK: DMG suffers losses on derivatives trades -- report.
newsitem.headline: DMG suffers losses on derivatives trades -- report.

text.p: Investment bank Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has suffered losses on options and futures trading at its New York office, a British newspaper said on Sunday.
The Observer said officials at DMG's New York operation said the losses were not material, and were a result of "a difference of opinion over valuation" in equity derivatives.
The report said the bank had refused to comment on the scale of the losses. Officials in London were not available for comment on Sunday.
It said the amount was understood to be far less than the 90 million sterling losses at NatWest following pricing problems on interest rate swaps.
